reviews.title: Stays Put All Day Without Irritation
reviews.body: I’ve tried a bunch of lash glues over the years, and this one has become my go-to. It’s super easy to apply (the brush tip is a game changer), and it actually holds my lashes in place all day without that annoying crusty feeling. I also have pretty sensitive eyes, and I love that it has aloe—no burning or watering even after hours of wear.It dries clear, which is a big plus, and it doesn’t take forever to get tacky. I usually wait around 30 seconds, pop on the lashes, and I’m good to go. Also, removing it is a breeze—no pulling or leftover gunk.Overall, it’s reliable, gentle, and affordable. Definitely a solid pick if you want your lashes to stay put without the drama.
